Position Overview

Primary Purpose of Position

The Willie A. Deese College of Business & Economics at North
Carolina Agricultural and Technical State University is seeking a
dynamic and dedicated individual to join our team as a Part-Time
Instructor. The selected candidate will be responsible for teaching
student success and professional development courses as part of our
student success colloquium. Courses may include Student Success
Colloquium ( FRST 101, COBE 201, and/or COBE 301). This position
offers an excellent opportunity to make a meaningful impact on
students’ academic and professional journeys.

Responsibilities:
• Develop and deliver engaging and interactive course content
focused on key skills for academic success, including time
management, study strategies, goal setting, and academic
planning.
• Provide personalized guidance and support to students to help
them navigate the college experience and achieve their academic and
career/professional goals.
• Cultivate a positive and inclusive learning environment that
encourages student engagement and participation.
• Monitor student progress and performance, offering timely
feedback and support to promote student success.
• Collaborate with fellow instructors and administrators to ensure
the course effectively meets student needs and objectives.

Part-time, temporary, flexible hours, with a potential course load
of 3-6 credit hours. In person instruction. Part-Time Instructors
are hired on a semester-by-semester basis.

Primary Function of Organizational Unit

N.C. A&T State University, is located in Greensboro, NC. An
1890 land-grant, doctoral, high research activity university, North
Carolina Agricultural and Technical State University prepares
students to advance the human condition and facilitate economic
growth in North Carolina and beyond by providing a preeminent and
diverse educational experience through teaching, research and
scholarly application of knowledge.

The Willie A. Deese College of Business and Economics at North
Carolina A&T State University has proudly maintained
accreditation by the American Assembly of Collegiate Schools of
Business ( AACSB International) since 1979.

The Accounting accreditation has been in place since 1986. The most
recent reaffirmation of accreditation occurred in fall 2021.

The Deese College of Business and Economics is a thriving college
with a new commitment that includes advancing graduate education,
seeking opportunities to establish doctoral programs, advancing
graduate education and research expansion.

https://www.ncat.edu/cobe/index.php


Minimum Requirements

• Master’s degree in education, business, or a related field.

Preferred Years Experience, Skills, Training,
Education

• Previous teaching or mentoring experience, preferably in a higher
education setting.
• Knowledge of student success strategies and best practices in
academic support.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
• Ability to effectively engage with a diverse student
population.
• Background in business, marketing, or entrepreneurship is
encouraged.
